stops.name: Dachstein Glacier
stops.quote: The high plateau of Ramsau am Dachstein offers a variaty of trails for classic technique and skating with up to 220 kilometers. In addition to highlights such as the high-altitude trails on the Dachstein or the night trail in the Ramsau stadium, the valley trails complete the cross-country skiing offer in the Schladming-Dachstein region.
